review.reason: The course layout, mapped hazards, water, tees, walking connectors, and striped fairways are represented clearly. The putting greens have a conspicuous inset-disc and ringed treatment that does not read as one continuous natural close-mown surface.

issues.detail: All three greens are presented as bright inset discs surrounded by broad, strongly contrasting dark rings, giving them a bullseye or raised-platform appearance rather than a single continuous natural sage/apple-green surface.
issues.consequence: Viewers may read each green as a separate inner target or tier, making the putting surfaces appear unlike the specified natural greens.
